sloka: गदयाभिहतस्तेन मालिना गरुडो भृशम् ।रणात्पराङ्मुखं देवं कृतवान्वेदनातुरः ।। ७.७.३९ ॥
transliteration: gadayābhihatastena mālinā garuḍo bhṛśam ।raṇātparāṅmukhaṁ devaṁ kṛtavānvedanāturaḥ ।। 7.7.39 ॥

translations.english: Severely struck by Mali's mace, Garuda, distressed by the pain, caused the god (Vishnu) to turn away from the battle.
